actor_awards.notes: A Mexican actor with a career spanning seven decades. He won an Emmy for his role in the miniseries 'How the West Was Won' (1978). He is arguably best known as the mysterious Mr. Roarke on the TV series 'Fantasy Island' and as the iconic villain Khan Noonien Singh in 'Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan'.

filmography.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
filmography.role_description: A genetically engineered tyrant from the 20th century who seeks vengeance against Admiral James T. Kirk.
filmography.plot: With the assistance of the Enterprise crew, Admiral Kirk must stop an old nemesis, Khan Noonien Singh, from using the life-generating Genesis Device as the ultimate weapon.
filmography.awards: Saturn Award: Nomination – Best Supporting Actor

filmography.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
filmography.role_description: A wealthy, corrupt businessman orchestrating a plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II using mind control.
filmography.plot: Incompetent police Lieutenant Frank Drebin must try to foil an attempt to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II.

filmography.title: Escape from the Planet of the Apes
filmography.role_description: A compassionate circus owner who protects the talking chimpanzees Cornelius and Zira, and later their infant son.
filmography.plot: The world is shocked by the appearance of three talking chimpanzees, who arrived mysteriously in a U.S. spacecraft.

filmography.title: Conquest of the Planet of the Apes
filmography.role_description: Montalbán reprises his role, having raised the intelligent ape Caesar in secret, until a tragic confrontation with authorities.
filmography.plot: In a futuristic world that has embraced ape slavery, Caesar, the son of the late simians Cornelius and Zira, surfaces after almost twenty years of hiding out from the authorities, and prepares for a slave revolt against humanity.

filmography.title: Border Incident
filmography.role_description: A Mexican federal agent who goes undercover as an undocumented immigrant to infiltrate a vicious smuggling ring.
filmography.plot: U.S. and Mexican federal agents team up to break a ring that smuggles illegal Mexican workers into California and then robs and murders them.

filmography.title: Mystery Street
filmography.role_description: A dedicated police detective who utilizes early forensic science to solve a murder case in Boston.
filmography.plot: A skeleton is found on a beach, and Harvard forensic scientists work with the police to identify the victim and catch the killer.

filmography.title: Sayonara
filmography.role_description: A leading Japanese Kabuki theater actor who attempts to bridge cultural divides and helps an American pilot.
filmography.plot: A US Air Force Major in Kobe, Japan falls in love with a Japanese dancer, despite the military's opposition to interracial marriages.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Supporting Actor (Red Buttons)

filmography.title: Sweet Charity
filmography.role_description: An Italian movie star who invites the protagonist, Charity, to his apartment, sparking her romantic fantasies.
filmography.plot: A taxi dancer with a heart of gold looks for love in the wrong places, ending up in a bizarre religious gathering and a romance with an actor.

filmography.title: Cheyenne Autumn
filmography.role_description: One of the proud Cheyenne chiefs leading his people on a tragic, desperate journey back to their homeland.
filmography.plot: The Cheyenne Indians decide to leave their reservation in Oklahoma and return to their ancestral home in Wyoming, pursued by the US Cavalry.

filmography.title: Madame X
filmography.role_description: A playboy whose accidental death during an argument forces the protagonist to flee and abandon her family.
filmography.plot: A woman is forced to abandon her family and change her identity, only to face trial years later defended by her own son.

filmography.title: The Train Robbers
filmography.role_description: A mysterious and relentless Pinkerton detective tailing a group attempting to return stolen gold.
filmography.plot: A gunhand assembles a team to help a widow recover gold stolen by her late husband so she can clear his name.

filmography.title: Spy Kids 2: Island of Lost Dreams
filmography.role_description: The formidable and secretive grandfather of the spy kids, who aids them on a mission.
filmography.plot: The Cortez siblings set out for a mysterious island, where they encounter a genetic scientist and a set of rival spy kids.

filmography.title: Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over
filmography.role_description: Grandpa Valentin joins his grandson inside a virtual reality video game, gaining the use of his legs in the digital world.
filmography.plot: Carmen's caught in a virtual reality game designed by the Kids' new nemesis, the Toymaker. It's up to Juni to save his sister, and ultimately the world.

filmography.title: Fiesta
filmography.role_description: A young Mexican man who prefers music over his father's wish for him to become a matador, leading his twin sister to take his place in the ring.
filmography.plot: A retired matador wants his son to follow in his footsteps, but the son prefers music, while his twin sister is the natural bullfighter.

filmography.title: On an Island with You
filmography.role_description: A charismatic Latin American actor starring alongside Esther Williams' character in a movie being filmed in Hawaii.
filmography.plot: A movie star goes to Hawaii and gets involved in a romantic triangle with a naval officer and her co-star.

filmography.title: Neptune's Daughter
filmography.role_description: A suave South American polo player who romances the sister of Esther Williams' character.
filmography.plot: A mass of romantic misunderstandings occurs when a woman tries to protect her sister from a Latin polo player.

filmography.title: Battleground
filmography.role_description: A cheerful Mexican-American soldier in the 101st Airborne Division fighting at the Siege of Bastogne.
filmography.plot: A squad of the 101st Airborne Division copes with the Siege of Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Screenplay, Best Cinematography

filmography.title: Right Cross
filmography.role_description: A Mexican-American boxing champion whose career is threatened by a hand injury and his own insecurities.
filmography.plot: A champion boxer injures his hand and tries to hide it, while his friend, a reporter, falls for his girlfriend.

filmography.title: Latin Lovers
filmography.role_description: A charming Brazilian rancher who romances an American heiress (Lana Turner).
filmography.plot: An incredibly wealthy woman travels to Brazil to test her suitor's love and meets a handsome rancher.

filmography.title: A Life in the Balance
filmography.role_description: A Mexican musician living in the U.S. who is wrongly accused of a series of murders and must prove his innocence.
filmography.plot: A man is accused of murder and his young son sets out to find the real killer to save his father.

filmography.title: Let No Man Write My Epitaph
filmography.role_description: A ruthless drug dealer in Chicago's slums who exploits a vulnerable mother and son.
filmography.plot: A young man from the slums tries to become a concert pianist while dealing with his mother's drug addiction and a local gangster.

filmography.title: Love Is a Ball
filmography.role_description: An impoverished European aristocrat looking to marry a wealthy heiress in this romantic comedy.
filmography.plot: Matchmakers try to pair a wealthy heiress with an impoverished Duke on the French Riviera, but complications arise.

filmography.title: The Singing Nun
filmography.role_description: A priest who encourages Sister Ann (Debbie Reynolds) to share her musical talents with the world.
filmography.plot: A Belgian nun with a talent for music becomes an international pop star with her hit song 'Dominique'.

filmography.title: Joe Butterfly
filmography.role_description: A wily Japanese black marketeer and con artist who outsmarts American soldiers in post-war Japan.
filmography.plot: American soldiers in occupied Japan try to produce a magazine issue while dealing with a resourceful local con artist.

filmography.title: Sombrero
filmography.role_description: A charismatic young man involved in the intertwining romantic plots of a Mexican village.
filmography.plot: Three intertwined love stories unfold in a Mexican village, involving feuding families and a bullfighter.
